findings.evidence: `TauCeti/NumberTheory/LocalField/AbsoluteRamificationIndex.lean:65-72` defines `FinitePadicExtension` with exactly an `Algebra ℚ_[p] K`, `Module.Finite ℚ_[p] K`, and `ValuativeExtension ℚ_[p] K`; `Basic.lean:111-114` instead raises `padicNorm` to unrestricted `Module.finrank`.
findings.fix: Require the existing `FinitePadicExtension F p` package, or explicitly require `Module.Finite ℚ_[p] F` and `ValuativeExtension ℚ_[p] F`, throughout `localCardNorm`, its K₀ descent, and comparison theorems.
findings.issue: `localCardNorm` assumes only `[Algebra ℚ_[p] F]`; for an infinite-dimensional extension `Module.finrank ℚ_[p] F = 0`, making every value 1, and no valuation compatibility supports its claimed interpretation as `‖#A‖_F`. The comparison theorems inherit the same missing assumptions.

summary: `localCardNorm` omits the finite compatible extension prerequisite, so it can degenerate to the constant value 1 outside the intended local-field setting.
